comment: Every directory under modules/ must be registered here with an explicit CN mirror decision; verify fails otherwise. artifact: 'build' = pipeline builds the zip from this tree and creates the GitHub Release. 'release' = module ships local-only binary assets (gitignored); the maintainer cuts the GitHub Release from a local full build and the pipeline mirrors those exact release bytes.

sheetshare-mobile.reason: Own MIT module; assets/ (example avatar png) stays local-only

arcane-spells-2014.reason: CN is served by the internal full pack arcane-dnd5e-2014-automation

arcane-assets.reason: Own asset module; assets/ and packs/ stay local-only, release zip mirrors release bytes
